versions.content: Freeze monitor activity numerator if the general denominator is inhibited If DemFreezeMANWhenGeneralDenominatorInhibited is set to true and the general denominator is inhibited via Dem_SetIUMPRDenCondition reporting a sta- tus set to DEM_IUMPR_DEN_STATUS_INHIBITED , all monitor activity numerator (and implicitly denominator) values shall be frozen throughout the end of the current driving cycle.
